stem.text: In each arrangement of resistors, the ammeter has a resistance of $2\,\Omega$.
Which arrangement gives the largest reading on the ammeter when the same potential difference is applied between points P and Q?

A.alt: Circuit between points P and Q with a 1 Ω resistor and a 2 Ω resistor in series with an ammeter A.

B.alt: Circuit between points P and Q with a 1 Ω resistor in parallel with a 2 Ω resistor, in series with an ammeter A.

C.alt: Circuit between points P and Q with a 1 Ω resistor in series with an ammeter A, in parallel with a 2 Ω resistor.

D.alt: Circuit between points P and Q with a 1 Ω resistor and a 2 Ω resistor in parallel, with an ammeter A in the middle branch.
